title: Harmonious Middle Eastern Egg Yolks Baba Ganoush
description: A floral and indulgent Middle Eastern dish featuring egg yolks, made in a ttukbaegi earthenware cook, and ayurvedic tamasic friendly, in the form of baba ganoush. This recipe combines the richness of egg yolks with the smokiness of roasted eggplants.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roast the eggplants in the oven for 30 minutes, or until the skin is charred and the flesh is tender.
Let the eggplants cool down, then peel and chop them into small pieces.
In a blender or food processor, combine the roasted eggplants, egg yolks, lemon juice, tahini, garlic, olive oil, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Blend the mixture until it is smooth and creamy.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Transfer the mixture to a serving bowl and garnish with chopped parsley.
Serve the baba ganoush at room temperature, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Cover and refrigerate any leftovers for up to 3 days.
